                    ### Question

On exam, he is also noted to be in the 99th percentile for height and 70th percentile for weight. He appears to have abnormally long extremities as well as an upward lens dislocation on ophthalmologic exam. A mutation leading to a defect in which of the following proteins is the most likely cause of his condition?

This is supported by the presence of long extremities, lens dislocation, and the role of fibrillin in microfibril formation. The evidence path showing the interaction of fibrillin with cells and genes involved in microfibrils further supports this conclusion.
